title: Sticky Yakitori Chicken Skewers
description: A simple, flavorful, and easy-to-make Chinese-inspired dish featuring marinated yakitori chicken grilled to perfection. Serve as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of honey, and 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar.
3. Add the yakitori pieces to the marinade and toss to coat. Let it sit for at least 15 minutes.
4. Thread the marinated yakitori onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the yakitori skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through.
7. Meanwhile, combine the remaining 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of honey, and 1/4 teaspoon of hot sauce (if using) in a small bowl.
8. Brush the glaze over the grilled yakitori skewers during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
9. Garnish with chopped rocket and serve immediately.
